description: Every student has faced this situation.

provenance.prompt: Every student has faced this situation.

description: It's the night before an exam. Lecture notes are scattered across PDFs, important concepts need revision, and time is running out.

provenance.prompt: It's the night before an exam. Lecture notes are scattered across PDFs, important concepts need revision, and time is running out.

description: Naturally, students turn to AI for help. They ask questions, get instant answers, and continue studying. But there's a hidden problem.

provenance.prompt: Naturally, students turn to AI for help. They ask questions, get instant answers, and continue studying. But there's a hidden problem.

provenance.prompt: What if the AI gives an answer that isn't even in their notes?

description: A confident response can look convincing, but without evidence, students have no easy way to distinguish a grounded answer from a hallucination.

provenance.prompt: A confident response can look convincing, but without evidence, students have no easy way to distinguish a grounded answer from a hallucination.

description: That's where Meeko, Study Companion from Real Notes, comes in. Meeko transforms ordinary study material into an interactive, evidence-first learning experience.

provenance.prompt: That's where Meeko, Study Companion from Real Notes, comes in. Meeko transforms ordinary study material into an interactive, evidence-first learning experience.

description: Students can upload their PDFs, organise their material into notebooks, and ask questions directly from their notes.

provenance.prompt: Students can upload their PDFs, organise their material into notebooks, and ask questions directly from their notes.

description: Behind the scenes, Meeko processes documents page by page, retrieves relevant passages, and uses Google's Gemma 4 to generate answers grounded in the available evidence.

provenance.prompt: Behind the scenes, Meeko processes documents page by page, retrieves relevant passages, and uses Google's Gemma 4 to generate answers grounded in the available evidence.

description: But the real innovation lies in what happens next. Meeko doesn't simply generate citations. It verifies them.

provenance.prompt: But the real innovation lies in what happens next. Meeko doesn't simply generate citations. It verifies them.

description: Every cited quotation is checked against the original notes using deterministic code. Verified evidence is presented alongside the answer, with page-tagged citations that let students jump directly to the relevant section of their PDF.

provenance.prompt: Every cited quotation is checked against the original notes using deterministic code. Verified evidence is presented alongside the answer, with page-tagged citations that let students jump directly to the relevant section of their PDF.

description: And when sufficient evidence isn't available, Meeko can respond with a clear Not Found, instead of presenting an unsupported answer as fact.

provenance.prompt: And when sufficient evidence isn't available, Meeko can respond with a clear Not Found, instead of presenting an unsupported answer as fact.

description: But learning doesn't stop at asking questions. Meeko also brings together AI-generated quizzes, interactive flashcards, explanations at different difficulty levels, and audio overviews, all in one study workspace.

provenance.prompt: But learning doesn't stop at asking questions. Meeko also brings together AI-generated quizzes, interactive flashcards, explanations at different difficulty levels, and audio overviews, all in one study workspace.

description: Powered by Gemma 4, with local inference through LM Studio, Meeko is designed to make AI-assisted learning more transparent, accessible, and privacy-conscious.
